remarks: Terrific seaside townhouse end unit located minutes from Stamford's own Chelsea Piers and a short walk to either Cove Island Park or Cummings Beach and Marinas. Comfortable and immaculate living spaces. Eat in kitchen with granite counters, plus living room dining room combination with access to your own deck and rear yard space. Second floor bedrooms are oversized, have hardwood flooring, ample closet space and share a full bath. The partially finished lower level is oversized and can easily be finished for comfortable rec space. Don't miss this seaside cutie with monthly common charges that include city water and sewer. Average monthly electric bill is currently budgeted at $414. Wardwell Manor is located at the quiet end of Wardwell Street and is pet friendly (one pet per unit) with a strong owner occupancy ratio and strong reserves!
